name: example
wording: A concrete case of a concept, given a situation, when something happens, then what must hold, including what must never happen; written for a story where misunderstanding is likely, it fixes what done means before the build, run as a check where that is cheap and repeatable and judged in review otherwise, so meaning becomes a description the work is measured against.
reason: The operator, 2026-10-15: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure; each role is defined by what it receives and hands over, each handover states what it must contain, and established practice is named rather than restated. Examples are written where misunderstanding is likely, and judged in review.
